description: Is there a shortage of this medicine in the US? Lists entries on the FDA drug shortage list for a generic name, most recently updated first: each presentation's availability, status (current, resolved or to be discontinued), company, reason, estimated recovery note and posting dates. For pharmacists, procurement teams and patients. Source: U.S. FDA openFDA drug shortages. US supply only, not UK or NHS stock; the FDA list does not show local pharmacy stock. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, maximum entries to list, 1-20, default 10

name.description: string, required, US generic name, e.g. methylphenidate, carboplatin, amoxicillin

status.description: string, optional, current, resolved or discontinued (to be discontinued), default all

name: fda_drug_shortages
